# `utils/DialogAnimations.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/utils/DialogAnimations.js`

DialogAnimations.js - Smooth open/close animations for all dialogs Provides consistent animation utilities for modals and dialogs

## Functions

### `smoothCloseDialog(dialog, duration = 300)`

Smoothly close a dialog with fade-out animation

**Parameters:**

- `dialog` *(HTMLElement)* — The dialog element to close
- `duration` *(number)* — Animation duration in ms (default: 300)

**Returns:** Resolves when animation is complete

### `smoothCloseModal(modal, duration = 300)`

Smoothly close a modal with fade-out animation

**Parameters:**

- `modal` *(HTMLElement)* — The modal element to close
- `duration` *(number)* — Animation duration in ms (default: 300)

**Returns:** Resolves when animation is complete

### `closeOnBackdropClick(dialog, contentSelector = '.editor-dialog-box, .modal-content, .settings-dialog')`

Close dialog on backdrop click (outside content area)

**Parameters:**

- `dialog` *(HTMLElement)* — The dialog wrapper element
- `contentSelector` *(string)* — Selector for the content area (default: '.editor-dialog-box, .modal-content, .settings-dialog')

### `closeOnEscape(dialog)`

Close dialog on Escape key

**Parameters:**

- `dialog` *(HTMLElement)* — The dialog element

### `setupDialogCloseHandlers(dialog, options = {})`

Setup all standard dialog close handlers

**Parameters:**

- `dialog` *(HTMLElement)* — The dialog element
- `options` *(Object)* — Configuration options

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
